about.title: About Her
about.bio:
Fehintola Onabanjo na Naija gospel minister, worship leader and recording artist. Her Yoruba and English gospel songs, like Omo Baba, Iji Aye and the albums Itura and Ara Edide, dey carry one message: salvation and new life for Jesus Christ.

She dey minister for live worship programme across Naija with other gospel ministers, and she dey share her music and ministry update for YouTube and social media.
